blocks.text: Custom Kitchens in Bratislava — Design, Manufacturing & Installation

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN is an interior design studio based in Bratislava, Slovakia. We design and manufacture custom-made kitchens in Bratislava for apartments, private houses and residential properties.

We manage the entire process: kitchen design, space planning, 3D visualization, technical development, selection of materials and furniture hardware, manufacturing, delivery and professional installation.
Custom Kitchen Design in Bratislava

Every kitchen is designed for a specific space and the client's lifestyle. We consider room dimensions, utility connections, built-in appliances, storage requirements, working-area ergonomics and the overall interior style.
We design straight, L-shaped and U-shaped kitchens, kitchens with islands, open-plan kitchen-living spaces and built-in kitchens extending to the ceiling.
3D Visualization and Technical Design

Before manufacturing begins, clients can see their future kitchen through realistic 3D visualizations. This makes it possible to approve cabinet colours, worktops, lighting, appliance placement and the overall interior composition in advance.

Once the design is approved, we prepare technical documentation for manufacturing, including cabinet dimensions, opening mechanisms, internal fittings, appliance placement, electrical and plumbing connections, and integrated lighting.
Custom Kitchen Manufacturing
Our kitchens are manufactured to individual dimensions. Cabinet fronts can be made from laminated particleboard, MDF, painted MDF, veneer and other decorative materials.
Available worktop options include laminate, compact laminate, quartz composite, ceramic, engineered stone and natural stone.

Kitchen specifications are tailored to each client's requirements and budget. Standard or more advanced furniture hardware can be selected, along with materials ranging from cost-effective options to premium finishes.
Built-in Appliances and Storage Solutions
Each kitchen is designed with consideration for refrigerators, ovens, hobs, dishwashers, extractor hoods and other built-in appliances.
We also incorporate pull-out systems, cargo units, internal organizers, waste-sorting systems, lift-up mechanisms and other practical storage solutions.
Kitchens for Apartments and Houses in Bratislava

We create kitchens for modern apartments, new residential developments and private houses in Bratislava. Particular attention is given to open-plan kitchen-living areas, where kitchen cabinetry should complement TV units, wall panels, wardrobes and other built-in furniture.
If required, DUMSKAYA DESIGN can develop a complete set of custom cabinet furniture for an apartment in a consistent interior style.
How to Order a Custom Kitchen

We begin by discussing the client's requirements and the existing room conditions. We then take measurements, develop the kitchen layout and design, and select suitable materials and furniture hardware.
Once the design is approved, we prepare the technical project and calculate the cost. The kitchen then enters production, followed by delivery and installation in Bratislava.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN Bratislava
We combine interior design and custom furniture manufacturing within a single project.

Clients can order an individual kitchen or a comprehensive solution for an apartment or house, including interior design, kitchen cabinetry, built-in wardrobes, walk-in closets, wall panels and other custom-made furniture.
Order a Custom Kitchen in Bratislava

Send us your floor plan or room dimensions, photographs of the space and a few examples of kitchen designs you like. We will prepare a preliminary proposal and recommend a suitable solution for your project.
